definitions.explanation: The study of places and the relationships between people and their environments. Also refers to the physical features of an area.

examples.japanese: {地理|ちり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地理|ちり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧ですか。
examples.english: Are you familiar with the geography of this area?

examples.japanese: {地理|ちり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned about Japan's mountains in geography class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してきた→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧なので、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地理|ちり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Since I just moved here, I still don't know the layout of this area very well.

examples.japanese: {地理|ちり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧でなく、⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In geography class, you don't just memorize the names and capitals of countries around the world — you also learn about climate and culture.

notes:
{地理|ちり} can refer to the academic subject or knowledge of an area's layout.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {地理|ちり}に{詳|くわ}しい: familiar with the geography/layout
- {地理|ちり}が{分|わ}からない: don't know the area

RELATED TERMS:
- {歴史|れきし}: history
- {社会|しゃかい}: social studies
- {地図|ちず}: map
- {地形|ちけい}: terrain, topography

SCHOOL SUBJECTS:
- {国語|こくご}: Japanese language
- {数学|すうがく}: mathematics
- {理科|りか}: science
- {社会|しゃかい}: social studies (includes {地理|ちり} and {歴史|れきし})
